# Switch

An on/off control for a setting that takes effect immediately, with the setting stated in the label and its state shown by thumb position and the words On and…

`SongNodes.Switch` · Inputs

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.Switch label="…" checked onChange={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.Switch" label="…" checked="{{yes}}" on-change="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (SwitchProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` * | `string` | The setting, not the action ("Sprite mode (performance)"). |
| `description` | `string` | What changes and when. |
| `checked` * | `boolean` | On or off. |
| `onChange` * | `(checked: boolean) => void \| Promise<void>` | Applies immediately; resolve to show "Saved hh:mm". |
| `disabledReason` | `string` | Disabled (aria-disabled, focusable) with the reason as the description. |
